title: Renew the registration on an SP2 crane
summary: Find out what you need and how to renew the registration for an SP2 crane at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
An SP2 crane is a truck-based or purpose-built mobile crane with a Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM) greater than 12 tonnes and overmass on one or more axles or axle groups.

To renew the registration on your SP2 crane, you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Own an SP2 crane (a truck-based or purpose-built mobile crane with a Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM) greater than 12 tonnes and overmass on one or more axles or axle groups).
what_you_need: An Authorised Crane Inspection Scheme (ACIS) inspection report
The PDF form – Replacement Application (only if you are not the first or second registered operator and do not have your renewal notice)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre to renew your registration.

external_links.text: Form 1018: Replacement Application – Transport for NSW – PDF
Authorised Crane Inspection Scheme (ACIS) – Transport for NSW
